at åbne.explanation: "At åbne" means "to open". You can open a door, a shop or a bank account. Hvornår åbner I? (When do you open?) is what you ask a shop or office.

sentence.en: I want to open the door for you.

et år.explanation: "Et år" means "a year". It is also how you give your age: Jeg er tredive år gammel means "I am thirty years old". Næste år means "next year".

sentence.da: Der er tolv måneder i et **år**.
sentence.en: There are twelve months in a year.

åben.explanation: "Åben" means "open", for doors, shops and windows: Døren er åben (The door is open). At åbne (to open) is the action: Jeg åbner døren (I open the door).

sentence.en: The shop is open until six o'clock.

åbningstider.explanation: "Åbningstider" means "opening hours": Hvad er jeres åbningstider? (What are your opening hours?). It is built from åbning (opening) and tider (times).

sentence.da: Butikkens **åbningstider** er fra ni til seks.
sentence.en: The shop's opening hours are from nine to six.
